Why: Introduces MinSight, our browser-based platform for fitting and interpreting Mössbauer spectra. It makes the technique easier to use by comparing users' spectra with a library of published data.
Shows how microorganisms create, alter and dissolve magnetic iron minerals, challenging the long-held view that the magnetic record in rocks forms through inorganic processes alone.

Here we showed for the first time that magnetite can act like a rechargeable battery for bacteria, storing and releasing electrons as iron-reducing and iron-oxidising bacteria take turns. It provided the foundation to our biogeobatteries research.
